fact: The World Bank IEG review says the land information system SIGIT was upgraded, operational and available when the project closed, and that 1,283,171 DUATs were recorded in it.
The World Bank IEG review says SIGIT included a web portal that enabled public access to the national cadastre land data.
Partners for Water reports that in Beira, 20 local staff were trained to scan and register 40,000 plots into a new database holding all land and property data.
Jornal Ikweli reports Nampula municipality began a property cadastre in February 2025 and had registered 44,706 properties by May 2025.

The MCC evaluation brief says most land offices have significant challenges in land record management and many rely on paper records because the land information system is not functioning or is only a back-up database.
